props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.name: type
props.description: The native `type` attribute. Never rely on the implicit `submit` default.

props.name: loading
props.description: Async action in progress: sets `aria-busy`, disables the button and swallows activation.

props.name: toggle
props.description: Toggle mode: the `@zag-js/toggle` state machine owns `aria-pressed` and `data-state`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled pressed state — only meaningful with `toggle`.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Uncontrolled initial pressed state — only meaningful with `toggle`.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description:
Marks the button as icon-only. An accessible name becomes a hard requirement
(`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`), enforced by the type and at runtime.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Height/padding step.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the control to its container's inline size.

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the combobox.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the combobox is disabled

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the combobox's input. Useful for form submission

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the combobox's selected items

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the combobox's selected items when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the combobox's selected items.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to autofocus the input on mount

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the combobox

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the combobox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the combobox.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the combobox. Useful for composition.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The controlled value of the combobox's input

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description:
The initial value of the combobox's input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the combobox's input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the combobox is readonly. This puts the combobox in a "non-editable" mode
but the user can still interact with it

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the combobox is invalid

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the combobox is required

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text of the combobox's input

props.name: defaultHighlightedValue
props.description:
The initial highlighted value of the combobox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the combobox.

props.name: highlightedValue
props.description: The controlled highlighted value of the combobox

props.name: inputBehavior
props.description:
Defines the auto-completion behavior of the combobox.

- `autohighlight`: The first focused item is highlighted as the user types
- `autocomplete`: Navigating the listbox with the arrow keys selects the item and the input is updated

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description:
The behavior of the combobox input when an item is selected

- `replace`: The selected item string is set as the input value
- `clear`: The input value is cleared
- `preserve`: The input value is preserved

props.name: openOnClick
props.description: Whether to open the combobox popup on initial click on the input

props.name: openOnChange
props.description: Whether to show the combobox when the input value changes

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description: Whether to allow typing custom values in the input

props.name: alwaysSubmitOnEnter
props.description:
Whether to always submit on Enter key press, even if popup is open.
Useful for single-field autocomplete forms where Enter should submit the form.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation through the items

props.name: positioning
props.description: The positioning options to dynamically position the menu

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: multiple
props.description:
Whether to allow multiple selection.

**Good to know:** When `multiple` is `true`, the `selectionBehavior` is automatically set to `clear`.
It is recommended to render the selected items in a separate container.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether to close the combobox when an item is selected.

props.name: openOnKeyPress
props.description: Whether to open the combobox on arrow key press

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

props.name: composite
props.description: Whether the combobox is a composed with other composite widgets like tabs

props.name: disableLayer
props.description: Whether to disable registering this a dismissable layer

props.name: navigate
props.description: Function to navigate to the selected item

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Do not mount the listbox until it is first opened.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Unmount the listbox once the closing animation finishes.

props.name: items
props.description: Option list. For async sources, hand in the current page of results.

props.name: collection
props.description: Pre-built collection (grouped or server-driven); takes precedence over `items`.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Local predicate over `items`. Async consumers that already filtered server-side
should pass `() => true` so nothing is hidden twice.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. A combobox without a label is a DESIGN.md prohibition.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Render the clear button when a value is selected.

props.name: loading
props.description: Async request in flight: shows the loading row and spins the disclosure glyph.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Copy for the loading row.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Copy for the no-match row.

props.name: renderOption
props.description: Custom option content; defaults to `item.label`.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Make the trigger reachable with Tab in addition to the input.

props.name: caption
props.description: `<caption>` content for the table.

props.name: q
props.description: Controlled search text bound to `DataTable.SearchField`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Request in flight: sets `aria-busy` and renders the loading empty-state region.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows to render (client mode: every row; server mode: the current page).

props.name: total
props.description:
Full result size when the origin already sliced the page. With `total` the
rows are rendered as given; without it the machine paginates `rows` itself.

props.name: page
props.description: Controlled page number (1-based) handed to the pagination machine.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: Initial page for uncontrolled pagination.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Controlled page size handed to the pagination machine.

props.name: defaultPageSize
props.description: Initial page size for uncontrolled pagination.

props.name: sortBy
props.description: Controlled sort column (`undefined` = unsorted).

props.name: sortOrder
props.description: Controlled sort direction (only meaningful with `sortBy`).

props.name: defaultSortBy
props.description: Initial sort column for uncontrolled sorting.

props.name: defaultSortOrder
props.description: Initial sort direction for uncontrolled sorting.

props.name: selectedRowIds
props.description: Controlled selection, keyed by `getRowId`.

props.name: defaultSelectedRowIds
props.description: Initial selection for uncontrolled `selectedRowIds`.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable row identity. Defaults to a string/number `id` property, then the row index.

props.name: getRowLabel
props.description: Human row name used for the row `aria-label` and the select checkbox label.

props.name: defaultQ
props.description: Initial search text for uncontrolled `q`.

props.name: error
props.description: Request failure surfaced through the `role="alert"` empty-state region.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Content for the `role="status"` empty-state region when there are no rows.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Content for the loading region while `loading` is true.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Enable the selection checkbox column.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the filter control — an example, never an instruction.

props.name: toolbarActions
props.description: Extra controls rendered in the toolbar next to the filter (filters, export, …).

props.name: showToolbar
props.description: Render the toolbar with the search field.

props.name: showPagination
props.description: Render the pagination nav, status and page text.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: role
props.description: The dialog's role

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Human readable label for the dialog, in event the dialog title is not rendered

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the dialog

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the dialog when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the dialog.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the dialog. Useful for composition.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Do not mount the dialog content until it is first opened.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Unmount the dialog content once the closing animation finishes.

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Whether to trap focus inside the dialog when it's opened

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Whether to prevent scrolling behind the dialog when it's opened

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether to prevent pointer interaction outside the element and hide all content below it

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description:
Element to receive focus when the dialog is opened.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the dialog is closed

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the dialog was opened

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the dialog when the outside is clicked

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the dialog when the escape key is pressed

props.name: triggerValue
props.description: The controlled active trigger value

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial active trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the active trigger value.

props.name: persistentElements
props.description:
Returns the persistent elements that:
- should not have pointer-events disabled
- should not trigger the dismiss event

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the content mounted even when closed (overrides `lazyMount`/`unmountOnExit`).

props.name: size
props.description: Surface width step.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content, right-aligned on wide surfaces (DESIGN.md: action row).

props.name: trigger
props.description: Trigger label. Omit it to drive the dialog with `open` instead.

props.name: triggerProps
props.description: Props for the rendered trigger (e.g. `variant`-styled `Button`).

props.name: closable
props.description: Render the close trigger in the header.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies this trigger when several triggers open the same dialog.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level rendered for the title.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled input value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the generated input control (form submission).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control (`data-disabled` + native `disabled`).

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the control as required (`aria-required` + native `required`).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the control read-only.

props.name: invalid
props.description:
Forces the invalid state. Defaults to `true` whenever an `Input.ErrorText` is
rendered, so an error is never signalled by colour alone.

props.name: ids
props.description: Ids of the field elements, for composition and server-side rendering.

props.name: label
props.description: Always-visible label text. Placeholder-only labels are a DESIGN.md prohibition.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text rendered under the control and referenced by `aria-describedby`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Rendering it drives the invalid state and `role="alert"`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder copy — reserved for examples, never instructions.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input `type`.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Escape hatch for the remaining native `<input>` attributes.
